## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; market shows mixed leadership with cyclical pockets (Materials, Industrials) but lagging Financials and mixed Tech — two confirmations for NEUTRAL. Leadership: Moderate (Top 5 span 3 sectors); Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +26.39%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: LOW (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.97% | 1M: +6.78%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +7.75% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +20.68%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials lagging: CME (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND, AIG (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -8.14%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -6.91% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND. Communication and Energy are weaker on the week: META (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -1.17%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -1.34%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND, LOW (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.97% | 1M: +6.78%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +11.66%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: Moderate (3 sectors represented), signaling cyclical-led upside rather than narrow mega-cap dominance.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CME (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -1.34%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -3.88% | 1M: -5.12%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -3.99% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND, MET (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -1.88%) BELOW TREND — weakness skewed to select Financial and high-multiple names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND, LOW (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.97% | 1M: +6.78%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +11.66%) ABOVE TREND — major divergence present as several mega-caps show 1W vs 1M mismatches, so treat momentum as tactical not universal.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed. GOOGL (1W: +4.84% | 1M: +3.64%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +11.66%) ABOVE TREND show pockets of strength, while AAPL (1W: -2.62% | 1M: -6.65%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -3.99% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND highlight dispersion; watch NVDA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION for leadership clarity.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautionary. JPM (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, C (1W: -4.54% | 1M: +5.95%) CORRECTION, AXP (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND and COF (1W: -6.91% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND show uneven performance; sector breadth slid, keeping Financials a relative weakness.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive but mixed. LLY (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +8.79%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +2.65% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND show defensive accumulation, while UNH (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +3.70%) CORRECTION signals some short-term profit-taking.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Neutral posture given mixed internals; favor cyclicals and materials exposure via NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +26.39%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.75% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND and consumer staples/retail leaders like HD (1W: +8.97% | 1M: +6.78%) ABOVE TREND and COST (1W: +7.69% | 1M: +7.85%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to underperforming Financials and select high-multiple Tech showing downside (AAPL (1W: -2.62% | 1M: -6.65%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt with caution due to mega-cap divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND, LOW (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AIG (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -8.14%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -3.99% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (NEM, FCX) — sector strength and momentum. BEARISH: Financials — broad 1W weakness and headline risk (credit-card fee chatter) may prolong pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch INTC weekly momentum for continuation after this breakout; NVDA hold of the 1M uptrend (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION is a trigger for tech leadership; AAPL staying below 1M trend (1W: -2.62% | 1M: -6.65%) signals ongoing tech dispersion; JPM failing to stabilize (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +5.11%) would reinforce Financials' caution.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (+55): GOOGL (1W: +4.84% | 1M: +3.64%) ABOVE TREND — news of Apple AI tie-up confirms price strength. META (+55): META (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -1.17%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines on AI are diverging from price, watch for distribution or delayed follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-65): UNH (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +3.70%) CORRECTION — negative Senate report confirmed by small pullback, monitor for follow-through. AXP (-50): AXP (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned. COF (-45): COF (1W: -6.91% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND — headlines on fee caps confirm weakness and elevated risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Materials and Industrials strength against lagging Financials and mixed Tech. NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND and LOW (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergence (multiple mega-caps with opposing 1W vs 1M signals) and negative Financials/credit-card headlines could trigger rotation or volatility.
